newsitem.title: UK: UK grains lower following disappointing tender.
newsitem.headline: UK grains lower following disappointing tender.

text.p: UK grains futures drifted lower towards the close on Thursday following a disappointing EU tender result.
The EU granted licences to export 192,450 tonnes of free market wheat at maximum refund of 6.49 Ecus and 153,000 tonnes of open-market barley ay 30.95 Ecus.
"The results been a bit of an anticlimax with tonnages below market expectations," said a trader.
At the close wheat futures were 0.15 to 0.55 stg down and barley 0.25 stg lower.
Turnovers were 486 lots for wheat and 86 lots for barley.
Amsterdam milling wheat were unchanged and tradeless.
Uk fob market traders reported no business and very few market while delivered traders said business had been "appalling".
